newsitem.title: UK: Globopar prices eight- and 10-year dlr Eurobonds.
newsitem.headline: Globopar prices eight- and 10-year dlr Eurobonds.

text.p: Globopar (Globo Comunicaoes e Participacoes) has priced its $250 million 10-year bond and $100 million eight-year bond, Citibank said on Tuesday as joint lead manager on both issues.
The 10-year notes were reoffered to yield 437.5 basis points over the 6.50 percent U.S. Treasury note due October 15, 2006. Goldman Sachs International is joint lead of this tranche.
The eight-year notes were reoffered to yield 379 b.p. over the 5.875 percent U.S. Treasury note due November 30, 2001. Bank of Boston Trust Co is joint lead manager of this tranche.
